title: WPSS/306/2021 of RAM SINGH Vs STATE OF UTTARAKHNAD

COURT'S OR JUDGES'S ORDERS
WPSS No. 306 of 2021
Hon 'b le Man oj Ku m ar Tiw ar i, J.
Mr. Tapan Singh, learned counsel
for the petitioner.
Mr. P.S. Bisht, learned Additional
C.S.C. for the State of Uttarakhand.
Petitioner's m other was Class-I V
em ployee in the Office of District Social
Welfare Officer, Dehradun, who died on
03.01.2019. Petitioner applied for
com passionate appointm ent. His
application was rejected vide order dated
19.12.2019 by Joint Director, Social
Welfare, Uttarakhand, which is under
challenge in this writ petition.
The sole ground for rejecting
petitioner's request for com passionate
appointment is that his elder brother is
in Government em ploym ent. Rule 5 of
the U.P. Recruitm ent of Dependants of
Government Servants Dying in Harness
Rules, 1974, as applicable in State of
Uttarakhand, is reproduced below: -
"5 . Recr u it m en t of a m em b er of t h e
f am ily of t h e d eceased - (1) I n case a
Government servant dies in harness after the
commencement of these rules and the spouse
of the deceased Government servant is not

already employed under the Central
Government or a State Government or a
Corporation owned or controlled by the Central
Government or a State Government, one
member of his family who is not already
employed under the Central Government or a
State Government or a Corporation owned or
controlled by the Central Government or a State
Government shall, on making an application for
the purposes, be given a suitable employment
in Government service on a post except the
post which is within the purview of the Uttar
Pradesh Public Service Commission, in
relaxation of the normal recruitment rules, if
such person-
(i) fulfils the educational qualifications
prescribed for the post,
(ii) is otherwise qualified for Government
service, and
(iii) makes the application for employment
within five years from the date of the
death of the Government servant:
Provided that where the State
Government is satisfied that the time limit fixed
for making the application for employment
causes undue hardship in any particular case, it
may dispense with or relax the requirement as
it may consider necessary for dealing with the
case in a just and equitable manner.
(2) As far as possible, such an em ployment
should be given in the same department in
which the deceased Government servant was
employed prior to his death.] "
 Perusal of Rule 5 reveals that
dependant of a deceased State Em ployee
will not be entitled to compassionate
appointment, if the spouse of the
deceased Governm ent servant is not
already employed under the Central
Government or a State Governm ent.
I n the present case, petitioner's

request has been turned down on the
sole ground that his elder brother is
em ployed under the State. Since Rule 5
does not indicate any disqualification,
based on em ploym ent status of brother
or any other m em ber of the fam ily
except spouse, therefore, in the hum ble
opinion of this Court, the ground for
rejecting petitioner's claim assigned in
the rejection order is not sustainable in
the eyes of law.
I n such view of the m atter,
impugned order dated 19.12.2019
passed by Joint Director, Social Welfare,
Uttarakhand is quashed. The Com petent
Authority is directed to reconsider
petitioner's application, as per law,
within six weeks from the date of
presentation of certified copy of this
order.
With the aforesaid direction, writ
petition is disposed of.

( Man oj Ku m ar Tiw ar i, J.)
